title: Giving Directions
description: Give and follow short walking directions.
objectives: Give and follow short walking directions.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to give and follow short walking directions. The central language is imperatives, turn, go straight, and location phrases. It belongs to the practical context of home & around town. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.text: imperatives, turn, go straight, and location phrases

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “Go straight for one block.” and “Turn left at the intersection.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: imperatives, turn, go straight, and location phrases.
